user.title: Add a Broadlink remote
user.description: The address of a Broadlink universal remote (an RM4 Pro, RM4 mini, RM mini 3 and the like). If Home Assistant's own Broadlink integration already has one, its address is filled in. Better Broadlink works alongside it.

data_description.host: Its IP address or host name, for example 192.168.1.27.
data_description.name: Leave empty to use the name the remote reports.

error.cannot_connect: No Broadlink device answered at that address.
error.not_a_remote: That Broadlink device can't record infrared (it isn't a universal remote).

abort.already_configured: That remote is already set up.

record.name: Record a button
record.description: Waits for a press of a button on a remote pointed at the Broadlink and keeps its code as a button entity. With On and off, it waits for two presses (on, then off) and makes a switch. The Recording sensor says what to press.

config_entry_id.name: Remote
config_entry_id.description: Which Broadlink remote. Only needed when there's more than one.

name.name: Name
name.description: What the button is called, for example Aircon turbo. Recording a name again replaces its code.

toggle.name: On and off
toggle.description: Record two presses: the first is sent to turn it on, the second to turn it off.

window.name: Wait
window.description: How long to wait for each press, in seconds.

add.name: Add a code
add.description: Keeps a code recorded somewhere else (Broadlink base64, with or without b64:) as a button, or two codes (on, off) as a switch.

config_entry_id.name: Remote
config_entry_id.description: Which Broadlink remote. Only needed when there's more than one.

codes.name: Codes
codes.description: One code for a button, two (on, then off) for a switch.

send.name: Send a code
send.description: Sends a recorded command's code (for an on/off pair, the first one). The button and switch entities do the same.

config_entry_id.name: Remote
config_entry_id.description: Which Broadlink remote. Only needed when there's more than one.

forget.name: Forget a code
forget.description: Deletes a recorded command and its entity.

config_entry_id.name: Remote
config_entry_id.description: Which Broadlink remote. Only needed when there's more than one.

cancel_recording.name: Cancel recording
cancel_recording.description: Stops waiting for a press. The record action then fails with Cancelled, so a script recording several buttons (with continue on error) goes on to the next one.

config_entry_id.name: Remote
config_entry_id.description: Which Broadlink remote. Only needed when there's more than one.

nothing_heard.message: Nothing was heard for {name} within {seconds} seconds. Point the remote at the Broadlink, close up, and try again.

already_recording.message: The remote is already recording. Wait for it to finish, or cancel it.

bad_name.message: Give the command a name with at least one letter or number.

one_or_two_codes.message: Give one code (a button) or two (on, then off: a switch).

no_entry.message: No Broadlink remote is set up in Better Broadlink (or the one given isn't loaded).

which_entry.message: More than one remote is set up: say which one.
